top_choice_rationale: P002 rewards a new organising principle: the time-reversal-protected Z2 quantum spin Hall state predicted by Kane and Mele and realised by Molenkamp's group in HgTe quantum wells. It is mature, independently reproduced and distinct from the 2016 prize. The citation scope is confined to the 2D case, so the Bernevig-Hughes-Zhang and 3D attribution weaknesses are acknowledged but defensible. P001 (optical lattice clock) is a clean, robust, fully acceptable second choice with a better-localised two-name credit; either award is preferable to no prize.
recusal_note: none apparent for P002 or P001 from profile; I direct WACQT and co-authored the dynamical Casimir experiment, but neither slate proposal concerns superconducting circuits.
